commands.label: Compile exact original resource with the upstream compiler

CMakeLists.txt.content_utf8:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(RezConsole CXX C)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 14)
add_subdirectory("${TOOL_CACHE}/tools/autc04-Retro68-v2019.8.2/source/Retro68-2019.8.2/ResourceFiles" ResourceFiles)
add_subdirectory("${TOOL_CACHE}/tools/autc04-Retro68-v2019.8.2/source/Retro68-2019.8.2/Rez" Rez)

reproduction_command: Rez -I. hello.r -o hello.rsrc.bin with the recorded TEXT resource definition
semantic_scope: The published compatible Rez compiler processed the unchanged original source and its resource file contains the named resource type and exact greeting bytes.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
